# P7: What a later school day costs a council

Citation: Navarro, L. (2021). Public Finance Quarterly, 17(2), 40-58.
Type: cost study (nine councils)

Abstract: Moving secondary start times by an hour meant rerunning school bus routes in all nine councils. Transport costs rose by 4 to 11 per cent in the first year. Two councils saved money in year two by sharing buses between schools.

My notes: Answers the question the head teachers always ask first.
